full_query: does a corneal abrasion usually cause discharge from the eye
sentences: Corneal abrasions can cause a reflex production of tears, which may result in a watery discharge from the eye
This is a common symptom of corneal abrasions, but it may not always be present
In some cases, the discharge may be minimal or absent, especially in the early stages of the injury
